assets.altText: At a Korean café, a mint mascot points to a takeaway bag. 포장해 주세요. means To go, please.
In a café dialogue, staff asks 매장에서 드시나요? and the customer answers 포장해 주세요.
A three-minute recall exercise asks you to say the takeaway line again, then points to a separate free Korean café mission linked in the caption.

review.evidence: The three full-resolution cards and 270-pixel phone preview were inspected for Korean and English accuracy, legibility, alt-text uniqueness and unclipped layout. The 450-character caption teaches the polite takeaway line before one direct tracked link to the freshly verified free Korean mission. This is a truthful acquisition path, not observed learning, conversion or revenue.
